_readme: Maritime resources directory (UNIFIED_MONITOR_PLAN.md §13.1, MARITIME_TRACKING_RESEARCH.md, researched 2026-10-09). Access classes: public_reference (human browsing only), free_authenticated (free key, server-side), contributor_access (requires contributing a feed), paid_api (credits/subscription), aggregate_official (official aggregate statistics), open_source_tool, incident_reports. investigation_url_template is null unless the provider's deep-link format has been verified; no deep links are invented. Nothing here is scraped or called by this tracker except IMF PortWatch (existing adapter).

sources.name: IMF PortWatch
sources.data: Daily chokepoint transits and port calls estimated from satellite AIS
sources.decision: Integrated (existing adapter): aggregate context, delayed and revised; not a vessel-by-vessel feed.
sources.limits: Latest values can be revised; AIS-dark and small vessels are not counted.

sources.name: MarineTraffic / Kpler
sources.data: Public vessel investigation; authenticated AIS APIs for positions and voyages
sources.decision: Reference link only. Public map access is not API access; no scraping of internal map endpoints; no paid integration in this phase.
sources.limits: API needs an access token; the legacy Vessels REST API is discontinued.

sources.name: VesselFinder
sources.data: Vessel identity, last positions, port calls, particulars
sources.decision: Reference link only; the API is credit-based and outside the free pilot.
sources.limits: Credits or subscription; trial on request.

sources.name: MyShipTracking
sources.data: Terrestrial-AIS vessel status, history tracks, port calls
sources.decision: Reference link only; a trial is not a permanent free source.
sources.limits: Trial 2,000 coins / max 10 days; tracks can be incomplete (terrestrial coverage).

sources.name: AISstream
sources.data: Live AIS WebSocket messages filtered by bounding box / MMSI
sources.decision: Preferred bounded pilot (package K2) — gated on a user-configured server-side key and measured regional coverage. Not connected.
sources.limits: Server-side key only; no durable replay or uptime SLA; 3 connections per account/IP.

sources.name: AISHub
sources.data: Combined AIS data for qualifying contributors
sources.decision: Conditional future source: requires contributing an operational receiver feed; not planned in this iteration.
sources.limits: ≥ 10 vessels in coverage, 90 % uptime; once-per-minute requests; no raw redistribution.

sources.name: Digitraffic marine API (Finland)
sources.data: Official open vessel positions, metadata and port calls in Finnish waters
sources.decision: Integration/reference example only — no evidence of Middle East coverage.

sources.name: searoute-py
sources.data: Computed GeoJSON sea routes between coordinates
sources.decision: Optional offline illustration (K3); computed routes are not tracks, carrier services or safe routes.

sources.name: UKMTO (UK Maritime Trade Operations)
sources.data: Maritime security advisories and incident notices
sources.decision: Report source, not a position feed; see UKMTO_ACCESS.md for the access state.
sources.limits: Advisories describe reported incidents; they are not tracks.

sources.name: NGA Anti-Shipping Activity Messages (ASAM)
sources.data: Anti-shipping activity messages and navigational warnings
sources.decision: Gated (package I2): unreachable from this machine on 2026-10-09 (CONNECT tunnel 503); not connected and not routed around.
